title: Hypotheses
text: Null hypotheses usually say “no real difference in the populations; sample differences are due to chance.” Pick the option that matches that AND is simulatable.

title: Option A
text: Can we simulate under A? Can we quantify “less effective” and how?

title: Option B
text: Is the vaccine equally effective in the two samples? Does that mean we can simulate under B?

title: Option C
text: Can we simulate two events being equally likely?
